d: The PCB has left Michael Atherton and Nasser Hussain out of the commentary panel for the Pakistan ODI tri-series, which has led to questions over whether the decision is linked to Atherton’s interview with Imran Khan’s sons. The move has put Mohsin Naqvi and Pakistan cricket’s growing list of controversies back in the spotlight. Rupha Ramani examines the Atherton and Hussain snub and the politics surrounding Pakistan cricket.
